freeze_rule: Source identities and this protocol frozen before confirmation inputs; all input identities frozen before any confirmation fit

observations.supplied_forcing: compatible manufactured source terms supplied as observation inputs, not estimated engineering forcing

training_rule: Scale, fit, restart selection, candidate selection and diagnostics use training only; heldout uses frozen parameters and signed coefficients, no refit
budget_interpretation: Equal maximum CPU allowance, not equal actual cost or guaranteed convergence. The program checks between calls/epochs and retains the actual overshoot, truncation and all restart records. Later restarts may be prevented by the common cap.
adam_scope: Conditional ADAM-SINDy adaptation to common weak inputs; not author-native end-to-end discovery or an unrestricted best-tuned benchmark. Uses entrywise amplitude penalty, bounded unit-box nonlinear parameters, unpenalized mandatory bases and no nonlinear threshold. Exact CPU weak Jacobian changes computation only; no WPHID post-fit refinement.

precision_gates.base_coefficients: separate descriptive errors, excluded from reaction precision gate
precision_gates.case_score: maximum of each critical relative error divided by its declared gate

Q1.block_score: maximum of the three role case scores
Q1.block_win: Both block estimates assessable, finite positive ADAM block score, and WPHID block score <= 0.9 times ADAM block score. Missing/failed/invalid/zero-amplitude decomposition, ties and zero ADAM scores are nonwins, all 18 remain in denominator.
Q1.qualification: Formal conditional advantage requires at least 13 block wins and WPHID precision pass rate not lower in each role; per-role rate gate is descriptive. No extension, tuning or case removal after results. Budget-exhausted but finite nonzero estimates remain assessable and truncation is separately reported.

Q2.same_role_correct_partition_fits: Reuse 18 completed Q1 WPHID fits by content identity, never refit
Q2.single_changed_factor: Only reaction internal-parameter partition. Same observed fields, family, active destinations, scales, signed independent amplitudes, base coefficients and optimizer budget.
Q2.interpretation: Paired descriptive component attribution. Correct sharing against saturated independence measures pooling in the shared role; wrong-sharing controls quantify misspecification bias. No post-hoc significance or extension.

Q3.search: All 43 candidates fitted; no candidate omitted by reference-center screen; family, all nonempty equation supports and all support partitions plus null are open
Q3.scope_limit: Small independent final-version qualification of the one-reaction full finite space under a declared per-candidate budget. Not a three-class 79507-candidate confirmation, calibrated confidence or a new end-to-end ADAM comparison. Historical multi-class and engineering evidence retains its original version identity.

remaining_without_invented_evidence: all coexisting mechanism parameters recovered by one fully open final-version fit
author-native fully tuned ADAM or WENDy-MLE performance
current publisher author-guide requirements if official access remains unavailable
